summary: Completed testing of Geofence Push Notification feature for managers. All 8 features requested were verified successfully. Backend APIs (alerts/recent, alerts/count) working correctly. Frontend notification bell visible for admin users with correct badge count, toggle functionality, and toast notifications.

notification_bell_visibility.description: Notification bell icon visible in header for admin users only
notification_bell_visibility.evidence: Bell button with data-testid='geofence-notif-toggle-btn' found and visible

badge_count.description: Notification bell shows unread alert count badge when alerts exist
badge_count.evidence: Badge showed '1' when 1 unread alert existed, updated to reflect current count

toggle_notifications.description: Toggle notification bell enables/disables geofence notifications with toast
toggle_notifications.evidence: Toast message 'تم إيقاف الإشعارات الفورية' appeared on toggle

api_alerts_recent.evidence: Returns list of unread, non-dismissed alerts sorted by created_at desc

api_alerts_since_filter.evidence: Returns empty array for future timestamps, includes alerts after past timestamps

api_alerts_count.evidence: Returns {count: N} matching number of unread/non-dismissed alerts in DB

api_mark_read.evidence: Count decreased from 2 to 1 after marking one alert as read

seed_data_creation: Created 2 test alerts in tracking_alerts collection for testing, then cleaned up after tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: Geofence push notification feature fully tested. Key components: Layout.jsx lines 496-597 (notification logic), lines 710-733 (bell UI). Backend: tracking_routes.py lines 1260-1309 (alerts endpoints). The bell uses data-testid='geofence-notif-toggle-btn'. Toggle state persisted in localStorage key 'geofence_notif_enabled'. Polling interval is 15 seconds. Bell is only visible for user.role === 'admin' or 'hr_manager'.
